newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich upped. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT 26/4]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich upped. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT 26/4]

text.p: -- Paribas analyst Nigel Kieser said Friday he had raised his rating for Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile SA, or Soquimich, to buy from sell.
-- "I'm very excited about the cement diversification that was announced this week," he told Reuters.
-- "I don't think it distracts from the long-term strength of the Soquimich story."
-- The company said this week it planned to invest $200 million in cement processing plants over the next two and a half years.
-- He set a four- to five-year valuation on the company's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of $77.
-- The ADRs were down 1-5/8 to 61 (Corrects price from 51).
